description: Look up the meaning of a tarot card: keywords, upright and reversed meaning, love, feelings, career and money readings, and whether it leans yes or no. Accepts names like "The Tower", "3 of Cups", "Queen of Swords" or "ace of coins".

card.description: Card name, e.g. "The Moon", "Five of Wands", 「月」 or 「ワンドの5」.

language.description: Output language. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese: Japanese card / hexagram names, meanings and links to the Japanese pages. Otherwise "en".

name: get_tarot_card_meaning
title: Tarot card meaning
